Have you ever caught yourself wondering—are you really the one steering your life, or is something deeper pulling the strings? It’s a question that’s fascinated philosophers, scientists, and spiritual seekers for centuries. Think about it: every thought you have, every choice you make, all seem to spring from this intricate mix of biology, upbringing, and the world around you. So, is personal agency something we truly possess, or is it just an idea we cling to?
Together, we’re about to dive into these mysteries through the lens of Free Will by Sam Harris. Harris challenges us to take a closer look at what’s really happening beneath the surface—where neuroscience and psychology start to blur the lines between what we intend and what simply unfolds. It’s a journey that stirs up big questions about responsibility, morality, and even who we are at our core.
As we peel back these layers, we’ll see just how deeply this question touches our sense of justice and compassion, the way we judge ourselves and others, and how we find meaning in our lives. By following Harris’s thought-provoking perspective, we’re invited to see how the belief in free will colors our everyday experiences—our relationships, our ambitions, and the way we view ourselves.
What if, by letting go of the myth of total autonomy, we could open ourselves to more empathy, humility, and a fresh sense of what it means to live authentically? That’s the journey ahead. So, let’s explore together—what really lies at the heart of our choices, and what possibilities begin to appear when we look at ourselves with new eyes.
